item.text: I’m using the theme-factory skill and will choose a theme to suit Maya’s portfolio. I’ll build the page in one self-contained file, with responsive layouts, writing filters, and a light/dark switch.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat .agents/skills/theme-factory/themes/forest-canopy.md && cat .agents/skills/theme-factory/themes/botanical-garden.md && ls -la && which node && which python3'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .agents/skills/theme-factory/themes/forest-canopy.md && cat .agents/skills/theme-factory/themes/botanical-garden.md && ls -la && which node && which python3'

item.text: I’ve chosen Forest Canopy: ivory, forest green, sage, and serif headings. The page will pair an editorial layout with custom SVG project illustrations, including an offline field app and a transit map.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','puppeteer','@playwright/test']) { try { console.log(p,require.resolve(p)) } catch {} }\"; ls /Applications | head"
/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','puppeteer','@playwright/test']) { try { console.log(p,require.resolve(p)) } catch {} }\"; ls /Applications | head"

item.text: The page is written, including all four project illustrations, the featured essay, and the interactions. I’m checking the content, JavaScript, and layouts at desktop and mobile sizes. The newsletter form validates email addresses and explains that subscriptions aren’t sent without a service connected.
